summary: Too steep everywhere: 14-23% grade on a narrow hillside street.
reasons: Narrow street, no room beside lane
Flats 9 m and houses 14 m away

drivers.seclusion: Treed on the east side, but flats 9 m and houses 14-17 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed street, tree-lined, with no pull-off wider than a van.
drivers.traffic: Quiet side street running up from a main road.
drivers.convention: No signs; a few cars parked at the lower end, no van convention.

flags: Steep: mean 17%, max 23%, flattest 5 m step about 14%
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over the northern half, open near the bottom junction.
